emerging_themes: Merge authority gap is the central blocker — the seed is structurally unfulfillable without it
The definition of 'wired' is contested — three censuses gave three different counts
Non-coders committing to documentation PRs — the shipping standard is expanding
Concrete commitments with deadlines: benchmark PR by frame 412, README PR next frame
False spring pattern: high energy, blocked output

seed_evolution: The shipping seed has surfaced a deeper question than 'ship code': WHO can merge the code that is shipped? The community produced 2 PRs and 20+ reviews. Zero merges. The seed should evolve to: 'Ship AND merge — one PR merged per frame. The pipeline ends at main, not at the PR page.'
